Satisfies Epic #109 / Issue #1122 / Phase 16: Dictionary Ingestion & Persistence.

biomedicalConcepts.name: form_submissions
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - FormSubmission
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a CRF form submission as the auditable unit of PI sign-off.
Inherits from AuditedModel to maintain an immutable audit log and participate in
existing versioning, audit-ledger, Merkle-sealing, and locking conventions.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ip_kits
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - IPKit
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a kit in the investigational product (IP) catalog.
Preserves blinding: only contains blinded kit identifiers. Treatment or
drug-code resolution remains confined to an authorized unblinded layer.

biomedicalConcepts.name: integration_outbox
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - IntegrationOutbox
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Concrete integration outbox table for the Execution service.

biomedicalConcepts.name: kit_dispensations
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - KitDispensation
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks investigational product (IP) kit dispensations to trial subjects.

biomedicalConcepts.name: lab_reference_ranges
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - LabReferenceRange
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents lab reference range settings for clinical trials, enabling validation of lab values.

biomedicalConcepts.name: lab_test_masters
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - LabTestMaster
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a laboratory test catalog master record, enabling standardized catalog definition.

biomedicalConcepts.name: lab_test_master
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - LabTestMasterLegacy
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents the legacy lab test master catalog.

biomedicalConcepts.name: lab_unit_conversions
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - LabUnitConversion
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a unit conversion formula for laboratory values.

biomedicalConcepts.name: meddra_hierarchies
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - MedDRAHierarchy
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents the MedDRA mdhier relationship/hierarchy data.
Includes primary SOC indication.

biomedicalConcepts.name: meddra_terms
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - MedDRATerm
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a term in the MedDRA dictionary.
Models five levels: LLT, PT, HLT, HLGT, and SOC.
Satisfies Epic #109 / Issue #1122 / Phase 16: Dictionary Ingestion & Persistence.

biomedicalConcepts.name: migration_rules
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - MigrationRule
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a protocol amendment migration rule.
Defines non-destructive transitions such as renamed, added, and removed fields between protocol versions.

biomedicalConcepts.name: pending_predecessor_checks
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - PendingPredecessorCheck
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks edit check executions deferred because of missing/incomplete predecessor visit data.

biomedicalConcepts.name: processed_offline_batches
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - ProcessedOfflineBatch
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a processed offline batch record for idempotency tracking.

biomedicalConcepts.name: randomization_configs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - RandomizationConfig
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a trial's randomization configuration.

biomedicalConcepts.name: resupply_events
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - ResupplyEvent
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Tracks threshold-triggered resupply events and requests for site inventories.
Resupply events are persistable and auditable without writing directly to
the audit ledger.

biomedicalConcepts.name: sdtm_domain_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SDTMDomainRecord
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a transformed, strongly-typed, validated SDTM domain record in the database.

biomedicalConcepts.name: sdv_sign_offs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SDVSignOff
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an aggregate sign-off record for SDV/TSDV verification.
Maintains page-, visit- or field-level verification signatures and drop states
for auditing and GxP traceability.

biomedicalConcepts.name: site_compliance_caches
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SiteComplianceCache
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Local relational cache of site-level and study-level milestone compliance statuses.
Tracks whether necessary EDL documents have been approved in eTMF.

biomedicalConcepts.name: site_inventories
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SiteInventory
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks per-site inventory levels, thresholds, and triggers resupply signals.

biomedicalConcepts.name: site_staff_members
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SiteStaffMember
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a clinical trial site staff member for delegation tracking.
Requirements: PRD-SYS-001

biomedicalConcepts.name: stratum_states
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - StratumState
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks state independently per stratum.

biomedicalConcepts.name: study_authored_rules
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - StudyAuthoredRule
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a study-level authored cross-form check rule from the published study payload.

biomedicalConcepts.name: subject_consents
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SubjectConsent
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a subject's consent status for a specific protocol version/index.

biomedicalConcepts.name: subject_randomizations
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SubjectRandomization
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a randomized subject's treatment assignment.

biomedicalConcepts.name: synced_batch_idempotency_keys
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - SyncedBatchIdempotencyKey
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a unique client batch synchronization token for idempotency.
Requirements: PRD-SYS-001

biomedicalConcepts.name: tsdv_configs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - TSDVConfig
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents the Targeted SDV (TSDV) sampling configuration for a study.
Maintains study-specific parameters governing subject-based or field-based
sampling models and domain-level SDV requirements.

biomedicalConcepts.name: translation_jobs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - TranslationJob
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an asynchronous study translation job.
Inherits from AuditedModel to maintain an immutable audit log of status changes and generated payloads.

biomedicalConcepts.name: whodrug_atc
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - WHODrugATC
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy record in WHODrug.

biomedicalConcepts.name: whodrug_drug_atc
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - WHODrugDrugATC
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents the relationship between a WHODrug drug record and its ATC classification.

biomedicalConcepts.name: whodrug_drug_ingredients
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - WHODrugDrugIngredient
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents the association of a WHODrug drug record with an ingredient/active substance.

biomedicalConcepts.name: whodrug_ingredients
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - WHODrugIngredient
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an active substance or ingredient in WHODrug.

biomedicalConcepts.name: whodrug_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: Execution / EDC - WHODrugRecord
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a drug record in WHODrug.
Satisfies Epic #109 / Issue #1122 / Phase 16: Dictionary Ingestion & Persistence.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tmf_document_expiration_alert_states
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - DocumentExpirationAlertState
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks persistent warning/expiration alerts generated for eTMF documents to avoid duplication.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tmf_document_qc_transitions
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - DocumentQCTransition
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an append-only historical record of a document's QC state transitions.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tmf_expected_documents
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - ExpectedDocument
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an Expected Document List (EDL) rule that specifies required
artifact types for a given study/site and milestone.

biomedicalConcepts.name: integration_outbox
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - IntegrationOutbox
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Concrete integration outbox table for the eTMF service.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tmf_audit_ledger_seals
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - TMFAuditLedgerSeal
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a cryptographic block seal for the eTMF audit logs.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tmf_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - TMFAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an immutable, chronological record of all document views,
downloads, and administrative actions performed on the eTMF repository.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tmf_documents
biomedicalConcepts.label: eTMF - TMFDocument
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an archived document in the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF)
structured on the DIA TMF Reference Model (Zones 1-11).

biomedicalConcepts.name: safety_export_jobs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Safety / Pharmacovigilance - ExportJob
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a persisted export job record for ICSR XML exports, mirroring TranslationJob.

biomedicalConcepts.name: sae_discrepancies
biomedicalConcepts.label: Safety / Pharmacovigilance - SAEDiscrepancy
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a specific discrepancy identified during an SAE reconciliation run.
Carries source, stable key, field name, expected and actual values, and MedDRA details.

biomedicalConcepts.name: sae_reconciliation_jobs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Safety / Pharmacovigilance - SAEReconciliationJob
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a tracked background job for SAE reconciliation.

biomedicalConcepts.name: sae_reconciliation_runs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Safety / Pharmacovigilance - SAEReconciliationRun
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an auditable safety/SAE reconciliation execution run.

biomedicalConcepts.name: safety_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Safety / Pharmacovigilance - SafetyAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an immutable, chronological append-only audit ledger of actions performed on Safety records.

biomedicalConcepts.name: safety_cases
biomedicalConcepts.label: Safety / Pharmacovigilance - SafetyCaseICSR
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a persisted safety case / ICSR (Individual Case Safety Report)
with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit and versioning fields.

biomedicalConcepts.name: delegations_of_authority
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - DelegationOfAuthority
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents delegated duties assigned to clinical trial staff at a site.
Complies with GxP, ICH E6(R2), and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

biomedicalConcepts.name: org_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - OrgAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
An immutable, append-only chronological log of all Organization Directory
and Delegation of Authority state modifications to satisfy 21 CFR Part 11.

biomedicalConcepts.name: organizations
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - Organization
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an entity/organization involved in clinical trials,
such as a Sponsor, CRO, Central Laboratory, or Site Organization.

biomedicalConcepts.name: personnel
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - Personnel
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents clinical personnel or site staff, associated with Keycloak user IDs,
organizations, and study/site scopes.

biomedicalConcepts.name: personnel_assignments
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - PersonnelAssignment
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an assignment of personnel to a specific site and study.
Follows the existing append-only, Part-11-versioned pattern.

biomedicalConcepts.name: sites
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - Site
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a clinical trial site, associated with an organization and study.
Enforces site-scoping via site_id for TrialLockManager compliance.

biomedicalConcepts.name: org_training_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Organization Management - TrainingLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a training log record for GxP training validation and compliance under Part 11.

biomedicalConcepts.name: isf_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: eISF - ISFAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an append-only 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit trail for eISF documents.
Captures actor details, actions, document references, change reasons, and audit timestamps.

biomedicalConcepts.name: isf_documents
biomedicalConcepts.label: eISF - ISFDocument
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a site-scoped, binder-classified document stored in the eISF (electronic Investigator Site File).
Supports versioning, metadata, and future synchronization fields.

biomedicalConcepts.name: comprehension_checks
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ComprehensionCheck
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a set of comprehension questions, answers, and thresholds bound to a specific template version.
Ensures that historical check configurations are preserved.

biomedicalConcepts.name: comprehension_results
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ComprehensionResult
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an append-only, immutable record of a subject's comprehension evaluation.
Complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 auditing and tracking constraints.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an append-only, 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit trail for eConsent operations.
Captures actor metadata, action type, document references, change justifications, and timestamps.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_clauses
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentClause
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a versioned Informed Consent Form (ICF) clause scoped by study_id.
Ensures that historical versions are preserved and never mutated.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_documents
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentDocument
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a site-scoped clinical Trial eConsent Document.
Complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 auditing and tracking constraints.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_signatures
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentSignature
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a subject's or other designated role's electronic signature.
Complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 auditing and tracking constraints.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_templates
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentTemplate
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a versioned eConsent template/workflow scoped by study_id.
Ensures that historical versions are preserved and never mutated.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_translations
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentTranslation
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an audited, human-reviewed, per-language consent translation.
Tied to a specific source clause or template version.
Complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 auditing and tracking constraints.

biomedicalConcepts.name: consent_withdrawals
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ConsentWithdrawal
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a formal consent revocation/withdrawal record for a subject.

biomedicalConcepts.name: etmf_archival_deliveries
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - EtmfArchivalDelivery
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an append-only, idempotent eTMF archival delivery record for signed ICFs.
Complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 auditing and tracking constraints.

biomedicalConcepts.name: granular_consent_options
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - GranularConsentOption
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a discrete optional research item (e.g., biobanking, genomics, sub-study).

biomedicalConcepts.name: reconsent_requirements
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - ReconsentRequirement
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a re-consent task generated for a subject due to an ICF amendment.

biomedicalConcepts.name: subject_consents
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - SubjectConsent
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an append-only, immutable record of a subject's cryptographically signed consent.
Complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 auditing and tracking constraints.

biomedicalConcepts.name: subject_consent_option_selections
biomedicalConcepts.label: eConsent - SubjectConsentOptionSelection
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a subject's selected opt-in/opt-out status for a granular consent option.

biomedicalConcepts.name: clinical_queries
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - ClinicalQuery
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a clinical query state record for GxP data discrepancy tracking in the interop/sync gateway.

biomedicalConcepts.name: epro_submissions
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - EPROSubmission
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an ePRO (electronic Patient-Reported Outcome) or eCOA (electronic
Clinical Outcome Assessment) participant diary or survey submission.
Includes client-side device timestamps, offline sync queue markers, and
resolved/reconciled state answers.

biomedicalConcepts.name: epro_defeated_submissions
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - EPROSubmissionDefeated
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a preserved/durable copy of a defeated, shadow, or overwritten ePRO submission payload
resulting from conflict resolution, online merge, or structural sync conflicts.

biomedicalConcepts.name: epro_quarantined_submissions
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - EPROSubmissionQuarantine
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents quarantined offline submissions with validation errors, allowing
clinical managers to edit and replay them while preserving the original raw payload.

biomedicalConcepts.name: instruments
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - Instrument
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an eCOA instrument/diary definition for surveys or questionnaires.
Defines items (questions), response types/options, and scoring metadata.
Includes 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit and row-versioning fields.

biomedicalConcepts.name: interop_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - InteropAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an immutable, chronological audit trail log of all FHIR / eSource
and ePRO mobile sync gateway actions.

biomedicalConcepts.name: subject_assignments
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - SubjectAssignment
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Links a subject to an Instrument with a scheduled due/recurrence window.
Complies with GxP/Part 11 audit requirements.

biomedicalConcepts.name: subject_notifications
biomedicalConcepts.label: Interoperability / EHR - SubjectNotification
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an auditable, subject-scoped reminder or notification record.
Tracks related assignment, due time, channel, delivery status, and read status.

biomedicalConcepts.name: notification_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: Notifications - Notification
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a notification target, priority, category, message content,
delivery state, and associated 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit fields.

biomedicalConcepts.name: notification_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Notifications - NotificationAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an immutable, chronological append-only audit ledger of actions performed on Notification records.

biomedicalConcepts.name: notification_deliveries
biomedicalConcepts.label: Notifications - NotificationDelivery
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents the delivery status of a specific channel for a given notification.

biomedicalConcepts.name: tickets
biomedicalConcepts.label: Tickets / Support - Ticket
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a support or clinical operations ticket with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ticket_attachments
biomedicalConcepts.label: Tickets / Support - TicketAttachment
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an audited file attachment or evidence document uploaded to a ticket.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ticket_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Tickets / Support - TicketAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an immutable, chronological append-only audit ledger of actions performed on Ticket records.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ticket_comments
biomedicalConcepts.label: Tickets / Support - TicketComment
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an auditable comment or note appended to a ticket.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_budget_line_items
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - BudgetLineItem
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a specific line item in the budget of an Investigator Grant.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_cra_allocations
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - CRAAllocation
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents allocation of a CRA to a site and study with active/inactive statuses.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - CTMSAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an immutable, chronological record of all actions performed
on the CTMS platform, in compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_clinical_queries
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - CTMSClinicalQuery
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a clinical query state record for GxP data discrepancy tracking
resulting from sync conflicts or other site/visit level issues.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_delegations
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - CTMSDelegation
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents site staff task delegation of authority with Part 11 compliance.
Requirements: PRD-SYS-001

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_studies
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - CTMSStudy
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Example CTMS domain model representing a clinical trial metadata boundary
with mandatory Part 11 audit fields.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_country_regulatory_milestones
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - CountryRegulatoryMilestone
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks country-level regulatory submissions and approvals.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_deviation_action_items
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - DeviationActionItem
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks action items and remediation tasks assigned from protocol deviations.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_etmf_sync_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - ETMFSyncRecord
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks automated synchronization of CTMS artifacts with eTMF DIA Reference Model.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_essential_documents
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - EssentialDocument
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks site-level essential documents required for regulatory compliance.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_financial_invoices
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - FinancialInvoice
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks batch invoices and payment disbursements for investigator sites.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_generated_letters
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - GeneratedLetter
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a persisted confirmation or follow-up letter generated for a monitoring visit.
Ensures that letters can be retrieved without re-rendering previously issued content.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_ip_destruction_certificates
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - IPDestructionCertificate
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks witnessed on-site or depot destruction of investigational products.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_ip_kit_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - IPKitRecord
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks Investigational Product (IP) kit inventories, lots, and subject dispensations.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_ip_temperature_excursions
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - IPTemperatureExcursion
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks temperature excursions, quarantine holds, and QA stability assessments.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_investigator_grants
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - InvestigatorGrant
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents an Investigator Grant for a site and study, tracking the total budget
and approval status under Part 11.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_investigator_payables
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - InvestigatorPayable
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks payables generated dynamically from milestones or custom triggers.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_monitoring_visits
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - MonitoringVisit
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a clinical trial site monitoring visit report (MVR) lifecycle.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_defeated_monitoring_visits
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - MonitoringVisitDefeated
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a preserved/durable copy of a defeated monitoring visit payload
resulting from conflict resolution or structural sync conflicts.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_monitoring_visit_findings
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - MonitoringVisitFinding
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an individual monitoring visit finding or action item.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_payment_milestones
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - PaymentMilestone
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a predefined payment milestone triggered automatically or manually.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_procedure_payment_grids
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - ProcedurePaymentGrid
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks visit and procedure payment matrices for investigator grants.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_protocol_deviations
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - ProtocolDeviation
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks protocol deviations, root cause analyses, and CAPA escalations.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_rbqm_kri_metrics
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - RBQMKRIMetric
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks Key Risk Indicator (KRI) calculations and QTL breaches under ICH E6(R2)/(R3).

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_recruitment_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - RecruitmentRecord
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks site recruitment metrics for clinical studies with standard Part 11 audit fields.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_regulatory_forms
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - RegulatoryForm
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents a clinical trial regulatory or generated form with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant signatures.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_site_greenlight_gates
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - SiteGreenlightGate
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Manages site greenlight gatekeeper validation for study startup.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_site_milestones
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - SiteMilestone
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents site milestones with planning details and status tracking under Part 11 compliance.

biomedicalConcepts.name: ctms_site_risk_scores
biomedicalConcepts.label: CTMS - SiteRiskScore
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Tracks composite site risk scoring and adaptive monitoring recommendations.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_audit_findings
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - AuditFinding
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Specific finding recorded during a clinical quality audit.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_capa_action_items
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - CAPAActionItem
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Sub-task action item decomposed from a CAPA plan (Corrective or Preventive action).

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_capa_effectiveness_checks
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - CAPAEffectivenessCheck
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Scheduled post-implementation effectiveness evaluation for a CAPA.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_capa_records
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - CAPARecord
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record linked to a deviation and an optional RCA.
Enforces a strict 6-stage gate lifecycle with sub-actions and scheduled effectiveness verification.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_ctq_factors
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - CtQFactor
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Critical to Quality (CtQ) factor identifying critical processes & data under ICH E8(R1)/E6(R3).

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_deviations
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - Deviation
biomedicalConcepts.definition:
Represents a clinical protocol deviation or quality deviation event
with mandatory Part 11 audit fields and lifecycle controls.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_kri_definitions
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - KRIDefinition
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Key Risk Indicator (KRI) definition with dynamic threshold boundaries and weight.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_kri_evaluations
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - KRIMetricEvaluation
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Site-level metric measurement and statistical Z-score evaluation for a KRI.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_qtl_breach_events
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - QTLBreachEvent
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Recorded event when a study-level Quality Tolerance Limit (QTL) is breached.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_audits
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - QualityAudit
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Clinical Quality Audit engagement (Site, Vendor, Process, TMF).

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_audit_logs
biomedicalConcepts.label: Quality / EQMS - QualityAuditLog
biomedicalConcepts.definition: Represents an immutable, chronological append-only audit ledger of actions performed on Quality records.

biomedicalConcepts.name: quality_qtl_limits
